decision.how_obtained: The owner was presented with three options, accept and open, decline and bootout, or accept deployment but shift the window start, together with the running-state facts and the reviewer's prior activation verdict. The owner selected accept and open.
decision.not_inferred: This acceptance was given explicitly by the owner. Neither the reviewer nor the operator treated the running scheduler as implied consent, and the operator correctly refused to do so.

verified_at_activation_review: installed plist 011164cef801f560c7fa5a7fe4aa8d0ed6551ba859e885eabebf79652ce64caf at mode 0600 with exactly nine environment variables
scheduler PID 26118 running with runs=1 and never exited; API PID 24813 healthy; old API PID 809 gone
JobRun 76955 news_poll ok under execution_mode scheduler and config v2.1, checkpoint 2026-08-08 unchanged
registered trigger yields 61/64/64 slots on 2026-08-10/11/12 with Monday 09:00, 09:30 and 09:40 suppressed and only 09:50 firing
whole-table URL and content_hash duplicate groups both zero, integrity_check ok, trading state 1 proposal / 1 SIMULATE order / 0 non-SIMULATE
the single five-second health timeout was classified as transient I/O contention from a one-off maintenance scan, not a sustained service fault

technical_exposure.treatment: Runs between deployment and 2026-08-10 00:00 CST are real and remain in the record, but they are NOT part of the three-trading-day window. The window is counted from 2026-08-10 00:00 CST.

first_day_focus.why_it_matters: Monday is the owner-confirmed deliberate host-disconnection day. This is the first live test of the v2 Monday policy carried into v2.1: 09:00, 09:30 and 09:40 must not fire and 09:50 must run as the recovery slot.
acceptance_evidence_must_report_separate: whether the suppressed slots produced no JobRun
whether the 09:50 recovery slot ran and its outcome
how the outage interval is classified in the coverage accounting

watch_item.statement: com.alphapilot.database-backup carries StartInterval 900. If it performs whole-database I/O it can transiently contend with news_poll runs, which is the same mechanism that produced the observed health timeout.
watch_item.action: not a blocker; if the window shows unexplained latency, timeouts or a failed poll, check for collision with the backup job before attributing it to the poller.

explicit_limits.statement: This acceptance opens the observation window only. Final P4.1 acceptance is a separate verdict to be issued after the window closes, on the basis of the three-day coverage evidence, and it alone gates P4.2b and P4.3.

next_gate: After 2026-08-12 closes, the operator submits the three-trading-day acceptance evidence and the independent reviewer issues the P4.1 acceptance verdict, pass or fail, under the same gates that produced the earlier honest red result.
